pages.title: Source
pages.text: This page maps formation_catalog.json, formation_items_catalog.json, and techniques/formation.json. The source materials group formations into aura gathering, maze, killing, defense, seal, teleport, thunder-guiding, and sect-protection arrays, with flags, disks, blueprints, divine sense, and realm gates as prerequisites.

pages.title: Playable Now
pages.text: seeking_immortals:spirit_gathering_array can already be crafted and placed. Use it to inspect local aura concentration and array bonus. A complete 13x13 floor of Aura Gathering Arrays, ten-high Spirit Ore corner pillars, and a clear 11x11 nine-block aperture form the current realm gate array used by the worldpack travel service.

pages.title: Learning Hooks
pages.text: The Wuyue Hall contribution shop already offers seeking_immortals:technique_manual_formation as the current formation manual carrier. Foundation techniques include Formation Sense, which reveals nearby arrays and aura boundaries, while Three Talent Sword Array and Big Dipper Sword Array provide early combat formation hooks.

pages.title: Catalog Route
pages.text: Low formations focus on minor aura gathering, maze arrays, and defense arrays. Mid formations include killing arrays, teleport arrays, inverted five-elements arrays, and wind-riding arrays. High formations add thunder-guiding stakes, Nine-Dragon flame disks, demon-seal pillar arrays, and Vajra prison arrays. Legendary and ancient entries point toward long-range teleportation, Five-Extremes Mountain, sect barriers, and Kunwu demon sealing.

pages.title: Disks and Flags
pages.text: formation_items_catalog.json reserves portable aura-gathering disks, maze flags, killing disks, defense disks, teleport cores, thunder stakes, array blueprint scrolls, Nine-Dragon flame disks, and aura-gathering flag sets. Most are still catalog entries; future slices should reuse the existing item registry, ShopService, JEI, and Patchouli surfaces.

pages.title: Deferred Work
pages.text: Portable disk durability, flag placement, persistent area effects, formation fuel, array detection and breaking, sect barrier arrays, a full formation-specialist skill tree, and formation blueprint drops are still deferred. Deployment should remain server-authoritative: position, materials, realm, method, cooldown, and cost must be checked on the server.
